query: INSERT INTO twitch_channel_match_state (channel_login, hero_id, hero_name, match_id, match_started_at, last_synced_at, is_live) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), $6) ON CONFLICT (channel_login) DO UPDATE SET hero_id = EXCLUDED.hero_id, hero_name = EXCLUDED.hero_name, match_id = EXCLUDED.match_id, match_started_at = EXCLUDED.match_started_at, last_synced_at = NOW(), is_live = EXCLUDED.is_live
